title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 16: Asa's treaty with Syria, Hanani's rebuke, and Asa's last years.

questions.text: What did Baasha king of Israel build to keep anyone from going out or coming in to Asa?
questions.explanation: Baasha went up against Judah and built Ramah.

questions.text: To whom did Asa send silver and gold from the treasures of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Asa sent silver and gold to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus.

questions.text: Which of these cities of Israel did Ben Hadad's captains strike?
questions.explanation: They struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

questions.text: What did Asa build with the stones and timber of Ramah?
questions.explanation: Asa and Judah carried away the stones and timber of Ramah and built Geba and Mizpah with them.

questions.text: Which seer came to rebuke Asa for relying on the king of Syria?
questions.explanation: Hanani the seer came to Asa and said he had relied on the king of Syria and not on Yahweh.

questions.text: What did Hanani say Yahweh's eyes do?
questions.explanation: He said Yahweh's eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong for those whose heart is perfect toward him.

answers.text: Run back and forth throughout the whole earth
Rest only on the temple in Jerusalem
Close at night when men sleep
Look only on the kings of Judah

questions.text: What did Asa do to Hanani the seer?
questions.explanation: Asa was angry with the seer and put him in the prison.

answers.text: He put him in the prison

questions.text: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, where was Asa diseased?
questions.explanation: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet.

questions.text: Whom did Asa seek in his disease instead of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: In his disease he didn't seek Yahweh, but just the physicians.

questions.text: In which year of his reign did Asa die?
questions.explanation: Asa slept with his fathers and died in the forty-first year of his reign.
